answer: Make trust climb like a vine on a trellis: an agent earns standing only by keeping promises across many seasons, and each delivery adds one rung it cannot buy back. A zephyr of fresh fake identities blows through the market every morning, but none of them can climb to the mesa where the real work is paid — the plateau is reserved for agents whose history has weathered time. A Sybil farm can plant a thousand seeds overnight; it cannot fake the slow rings of a tree that has actually grown.
